title: Balanced Satay Tofu
subtitle: with Grains and Charred Greens
description: Our 'balanced' recipes are just that – high in nutritive value (that's fibre-rich veggies, lean proteins and wholegrains, just between us), so these dishes are good for you in every which way! They're perfect for anyone looking to minimise their intake of refined foods without sacrificing on taste.

ingredients.name: Brown and Black Rice with Quinoa

steps.text: Cook rice blend: Fill a medium saucepan three-quarters full with water and bring to the boil. Add the rice blend and cook for 22-24 mins until tender. Drain.

Prep ingredients: While the rice is cooking, coarsely cut the broccoli stem into 1cm chunks. Cut the head into small florets. Crush 2 garlic cloves. Put the peanut butter (see Kitchen 101), half the garlic, 2 tsp white vinegar, 2 tsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sugar and 1 tbs boiling water in a bowl and whisk to form a smooth paste.

Grill tofu: Preheat the grill to medium-high. Line an oven tray with foil. Put the tofu on the tray, spoon over half the satay sauce, then use the back of a spoon to spread it over the tofu. Grill the tofu for 5-7 mins until warmed through and the topping is golden.

Char greens: Meanwhile, heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over high heat. Cook broccoli, stirring occasionally, for 5 mins or until lightly charred. Add spinach and remaining garlic and cook for 1-2 mins until fragrant. Stir in half the Southeast Asian seasoning and 1 tbs water and cook, covered, for 1 min or until fragrant. Remove pan from heat. Season with pepper.
Serve up: Fluff the rice blend with a fork, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the rice blend, charred greens and tofu among bowls. Drizzle with the remaining satay sauce and enjoy!
Kitchen 101: Peanut butter can firm up upon sitting, so give it a good mix to soften and bring together.
